verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Don't you be in such a hurry
Cause it only leads to worry

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
There's a time to work and
There's a time to pray

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Try to find a quiet place
To hear his voice and seek his face

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Can you hear the Spirit calling
Come away

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come and spend some time with me
Come away

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Let your heart and mind be stilled
Let your empty cup be filled

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Come and spend some time with me
Come away

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Are you seeking in your sorrow
Are you worried 'bout tomorrow

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: Are the pressures of this life too hard to bear

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
If you cast your cares on him
He'll give you perfect peace within

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
Can you hear the spirit calling
Come away
